newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs seen steady-lower, pork bellies steady-up.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs seen steady-lower, pork bellies steady-up.

text.p: CME hog futures were expected to open steady to 0.200 cent per lb lower while pork belly futures were called steady to up 0.100 cent, livestock analysts said.

Expectations for increased hog runs after last week's weather-delayed marketings in some areas and steady to mostly lower cash hog calls were seen weighing on hog futures. However, a strong tone to cash pork prices may curb the setback, analysts said.
Technically, the June contract may also be considered bearish after failing to hold a breakout, they said.
The April contract expires at 1200 CDT/1700 GMT and has no trading limit on its final day.
